texts.facts: In the present case, Detailed Accident Report (DAR) was filed on 09.09.2015 regarding a Road Traffic Accident, which took place on 10.07.2015 at 12.30 PM at Wazirabad Road, Surghat Bus Stand, Wazirabad, Delhi. In this accident, the petitioner Rajan @ Raju sustained grievous injuries and the accident took place with a vehicle i.e. TSR bearing registration No. DL-1NCR-1728 driven and owned by respondent no. 1 Vishnu and insured with respondent no. 2 Bharti Axa General Insurance Company Ltd. (which was merged with ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co. Ltd. vide order dated 03.05.2023). 2. It emerged from the DAR that on 10.07.2015, Sh. Rajan @ Raju who used to supply homemade food tiffin was going by foot from his home to his sister's home. He was standing at Wazirabad Surghat Bus Stand, Delhi when suddenly a driver of TSR bearing No. DL- 1NCR-1728 namely Vishnu came at a very high speed and hit the petitioner. Due to the said accident, the petitioner fell on the road and sustained injury on his left side back. Thereafter, respondent no. 1 took him to the Trauma Centre Hospital in his TSR. From there, the doctors referred him to the LNJP Hospital and he called his wife Sonu Anand. It is the case of the petitioner that respondent no. 1was driving his TSR rashly and negligently and due to his negligence, the accident took place. The IO recorded the statement of the petitioner and prepared the site plan at the instance of Sh. Vijay Kumar, brother-in-law of the MACT No. 57749/16 Rajan @ Raju Vs. Vishnu Tarun and another page 2 of 39 injured Rajan @ Raju. TSR bearing no. DL-1NCR-1728 was seized and deposited in the Malkhana. During investigation, driver of the offending vehicle i.e. TSR got arrested and his statement was recorded and later on, he was released on bail. The documents pertaining to the vehicle were verified. Mechanical inspection of TSR was got done by ASI. Later, the TSR was released on superdari. The result of MLC was obtained as 'grievous' and section 338 IPC was added. Charge- sheet/challan was filed before the concerned court of Ld. MM and DAR was filed before this Tribunal on 09.09.2015. 3. No written statement/reply to the DAR was filed on behalf of the respondent no.1 (driver-cum-owner) despite various opportunities and therefore, the opportunity to file the same was closed. However, respondent no. 2/ insurance company had filed its reply wherein it was stated that they were not liable to pay any compensation to the petitioner as the petitioner did not have a valid and effective permit in respect of the vehicle as on the date of accident.
